levers_found.note: All three sit on OUR exact 0.947 base: haideptry's notebooks self-report source_notebook_sha256 3e65ca69..., the documented upstream of repro_059, with metric_hack_used false. Directly portable.

1_mutual_best_association.mechanism: rank bonus on the edge logits: beta*col_best + 0.5*beta*row_best + 0.5*beta*mutual - 0.20*beta*(not mutual), via BIOHUB_LB_SCORING_MODE=mutual_best and BIOHUB_LB_SCORING_BETA (0.20 in haideptry, 0.12 mentioned elsewhere)
1_mutual_best_association.why: It perturbs EDGE ASSOCIATION, ~85-90% of the aggregate metric. Every recent probe of ours (exp_055, exp_057, exp_060, exp_061) moved DIVISION, weighted only 0.1 -- the structural reason they were sub-precision nulls. This is the first shared lever aimed at the heavy term.
1_mutual_best_association.provenance: yudaiyamauchi published a systematic A-E series on this axis (A hard-negative margin, B hard-negative strong, C disagreement-adaptive, D relative rank, E mutual-best). haideptry carries BIOHUB_LB_EXPLORATION_ID='e-mutual-best', i.e. E is the survivor. The A-E notebooks have 0-2 votes, so this is not priced in.

2_density_adaptive_overrides.mechanism: determine_density_group() measures avg cells/frame and selects tight_um/relaxed_um/velocity_weight/learned_bonus: low(<120) 7.25/11.0/0.5/3.0, middle 6.5/9.0/0.0/6.0, high 5.5/10.0/0.5/1.0
2_density_adaptive_overrides.why: Generalizes the single global tight55 we froze. Cell density varies ~11x across embryos (61 to 703 cells/frame), so one global value is plausibly mis-set for three of the four movies.
2_density_adaptive_overrides.specimen_blind_verified: YES -- checked explicitly: the four public test movie names appear ZERO times in the notebook's code (prose only), the group is decided by measurement, and test discovery is a dynamic TEST_DIR.iterdir() scan. Satisfies our ground-truth-free / specimen-blind rule.

3_divnet_mitosis_gate.mechanism: BIOHUB_DIVNET_VERIFY=1, BIOHUB_DIV_MIN_PROB=0.50, weights from the public dataset giorgosi/biohub-divnet-v2 (5.2 MB, 455 downloads, available)
3_divnet_mitosis_gate.why_last: It is the first MODEL-level addition available to us, but it acts on division, the 0.1-weighted term -- on our own repeated evidence the least likely of the three to register at 3-decimal LB.
